senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Paneas (Cæsaræa Philippi, modern Bânias), a city in the north of Palestine.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 34:11">Targ. Y. I Num. XXXIV, 11</cite> <he>מערת פניאס</he> (not <cite ref="O01229"><he>סניאס</he></cite>); (Y. II <he>אפמים</he>, <he>אפמיס</he>; ib. 10 <he>אפמיאה</he>, <he>אפמיאם</he>, v. <cite ref="A02741"><he>אַפַּמְיָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 5:4">Targ. Cant. V, 4</cite> <cite ref="Q01138"><he>פָּמִיאַס</he></cite> (some ed. <cite ref="Q01141"><he>פָּמְיַס</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 21:2">Targ. I Chr. XXI, 2</cite> (h. text <he>דן</he>).—Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ bot. <he>דיקליטינוס אעיק לבני פנ׳</he> Diocletian oppressed the inhabitants of P. Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ top.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>נחת … בהדא פנ׳</he> (Var. <he>פמ׳</he>) he (Diocletian) came down and made his stay at P.

<cite ref="Megillah 6a:15">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 55a:17">Bekh. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>לשם זו פמ׳</he> Leshem is P.; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14 <he>ליש זו פ׳</he> Layish is P.; Pirké d’R. EI. ch. XXVII <he>דן הוא פ׳</he> Dan is P.; Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII (ref. to <he>דנה</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 24:6">II Sam. XXIV, 6</cite>) <he>דנה פ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:4">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>מעיין … מערת פ׳</he> the spring … of the cavern of P.; Bekh. l. c. <he>ירדן יוצא ממערת פ׳</he> the Jordan issues from the cavern of P.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:11">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite>.—

Yalk. Deut. 820 (Moses prays) אכנס לה במחילה … מתחת לפַמְיָס let me enter Palestine by the cave of Cæsarion, which is below P.; Mekh. B’shall., ʿĂmal., s. 2 לפניי ולפנים (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Tanḥ. Naso 10; Num. R. s. 11 (ref. to Num. VI, 24) יברכד … וישמרך שלא תהא עשוי במדינת פ׳ וכ׳ the Lord bless thee with wealth, and guard thee, that thou be not forced (to take office) in the city (or district) of P., and no zimia (v. זִימְיָא) be decreed over the city, and they say to thee, give gold (a reference to Roman extortions, v. supra).
